verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents API references for CKS cluster CRUD and the Inference API. These cover multiple transports and generated clients in Go, Python, TypeScript and other languages, plus an llms.txt index, so the reference itself exists and is explorable. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or API explorer, runnable or copy-paste example requests in the reference, and hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
